For visitors

The club’s calendar says routes for the Bakery Ride and the shorter 1/2 Baked ride are decided at the start, and riders sign a waiver on the day. The club describes its rides as no-drop and independent. The start park’s town comes from the Buffalo Grove Park District’s listing; the club’s page gives the park name only.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Pace isn’t posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you’re new when you arrive. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Arlington Heights Bicycle Club Bakery Ride group ride

Arlington Heights Bicycle Club Bakery Ride is a road and social group ride in Buffalo Grove, IL. It rolls tuesdays and Thursdays at 9:00 am from Willow Stream Park.

The club’s weekday-morning ride, with a shorter 1/2 Baked option, from Willow Stream Park. Routes get set at the start.
